spans.s:
Kvayī is the name of some species of bird in the yajurveda, occurring in the list of victims at the aśvamedha, or horse sacrifice. The form in the Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā is kuvaya.
Foot notes taittirīya Saṃhitā, v. 5, 17, 1; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 29.
iii. 14, 18.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 99

Kvala is a substance, perhaps identical with kuvala, the fruit of the jujube, used to coagulate milk according to the taittirīya Saṃhitā.
Foot notes St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
ii. 5, 3, 5. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 227.
